chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "Give charity and depart on whichever day you wish."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about giving charity and departing?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the act of charity (Sadaqah) directly to the ease of departure, reflecting the Shia tradition that charitable giving serves as a spiritual safeguard and facilitator for one's journey, whether literal or metaphorical. The flexibility in timing ('whichever day you choose') underscores the continuous nature of this practice, encouraging believers to integrate charity into their daily routines to secure divine assistance and remove obstacles.
